title: Forcing iterations, further preservation and Boolean completions
existing_coverage_and_exact_fact: For further preservation, reuse finite-map compatibility and the delta-system argument from `pressing-down-and-delta-systems#finite-partial-maps` and `pressing-down-and-delta-systems#uncountable-compatible-family`; the internal ccc possible-value, cardinal and cofinality arguments in `forcing-chain-conditions`; and countable-closure preservation of countable ordinal sequences in `countably-closed-forcing#no-new-countable-sequences`. For controlling real names in later iterations, use nice-name counting from `nice-names-and-cohen-continuum#counting-codes` with its explicit internal cardinal hypotheses.
remaining_scope_to_develop: Develop the Knaster condition and relevant iteration/preservation theorems, and forcing-axiom applications including Martin's axiom. A Boolean-algebra presentation additionally needs Boolean completions. Higher chain-condition and closure preservation results beyond ccc and countable closure require their own precise hypotheses.
